summary: Petróleos Mexicanos (Pemex), the Mexican state-owned oil company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for the month of August 2026. The filing is a free translation of its quarterly financial information report for the second quarter of 2026, submitted to the Mexican Stock Exchange. The document contains standard forward-looking statements and is a routine periodic disclosure of financial results. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or tender offer is present. The filing is purely a routine current report of financial performance, with no deal terms or strategic actions announced.
